GRN-03 promotes the use of energy-efficient hardware, and GRN-04 minimizes data storage requirements, reducing resource consumption. GRN-05 offers clients an eco-friendly option for transaction records, and GRN-06 saves energy by shutting down during inactivity. Finally, GRN-07 emphasizes the importance of assessing environmental impact annually. These requirements collectively enhance the sustainability of the ATM system.

transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I emphasize the critical importance of security and privacy in the ATM system. TRU-01 ensures that all transactions are encrypted during transmission, safeguarding sensitive data. TRU-02 mandates secure PIN authentication, while TRU-03 requires comprehensive logging for audit purposes. TRU-04 prevents negative balances, reinforcing data integrity. TRU-05 allows users to securely review their transaction history, and TRU-06 notifies users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals. Finally, TRU-07 maintains data integrity by validating account operations. These requirements collectively enhance user trust and protect sensitive information.

transcript.statement: As the SafetyAgent, I prioritize safety and reliability in the ATM system. SAF-01 ensures no account can have a negative balance, preventing financial hazards. SAF-02 mandates automatic fund withdrawal from savings to maintain account safety, while SAF-03 ensures users are informed of insufficient funds, preventing unexpected transaction failures. SAF-04 logs all transactions for accountability, and SAF-05 secures user authentication to protect against unauthorized access. SAF-06 allows for safe degradation during maintenance, and SAF-07 provides users with clear account summaries, enhancing transparency and trust. These requirements collectively ensure a safe and reliable ATM experience.

The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall provide a mechanism for safe degradation by allowing limited withdrawals during system maintenance.
The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The ATM shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving-account without user delay.
The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall implement load balancing to manage transaction requests effectively.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing to reduce idle states.
The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The ATM system shall ensure that all recorded transactions are logged in a way that minimizes data storage requirements.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The system shall ensure that all transactions are encrypted during transmission.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to review their transaction history securely.
The system shall automatically notify users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals.
The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
